method: Independent arithmetic from every saved wall-time row and raw worker resource samples; hashes verified against completion and the named result commit before full-report analysis. No evaluator comparisons/acceptance helper was used for recalculation.

strict_full_ledger_audit.scope: Separate strict evaluator audit verifies materialized original worker and attempt-ledger bytes. This review recomputes the complete aggregate saved rows and worker resources; it does not replace that ledger audit.

limits: The aggregate point estimate clears the 10 percent gate by only 0.1294 percentage points; this is a narrow observed pass, not a high-confidence population effect.
Four fresh process rounds on one hosted machine reuse the same old regression queries. No confidence interval, statistical significance, OS-cold-cache or new-domain claim is made.
The geometric mean equally weights twelve pooled configuration/cohort ratios; it is not a percentile pooled over different configurations or an average of per-round p95 ratios.
Positive pooled and per-round changes remain in the data. The public MCP character cell regresses in pooled p95, and some individual rounds regress even where pooling improves.
Native evaluator RSS includes reference tokenizers and retained audit rows. SDK server RSS is measured separately. Four startup/resource samples per source/cohort do not establish a population tail.
The review checks recorded hashes, invariants and budget metadata; omitted response bodies are not re-tokenized or reconstructed.
This is a default lexical recall comparison with v0.3.1, not a comparator-repository or whole-product benchmark. Fresh validation, packaging and release gates remain separate.
